title: Silver Crash Alert: The Fed Just Moved Against This Signal
speaker: Eric (Summit Metals)

macro_themes.view: 10-year at ~5.27% shows the market does not believe the softer inflation data; lower hike odds don't guarantee lower yields, pressuring metals.
October hike odds fell to ~35% but he expects a December hike to stay priced given 3.4% inflation vs the 2% target.
ADP +90K vs ~70K expected was hawkish and is what knocked metals down today.
Rising debt and inflation that will debase the currency remain fully intact for gold and silver.

calls.condition: To repair the sell-off gold needs to clear the 4,230 hurdle and hold today's 4,111 low, and above all stay above $4,000.
calls.reason: Bond-yield pressure and a hot jobs print weigh short term (pressure index 52 to 49, still favourable but can't confirm a bottom); long-term debasement drivers intact. Favours gold over silver; advises small, consistent buys and saving cash for a bigger dip.
calls.quote: right now I remain cautious... I would just stay consistent, small

calls.condition: Silver needs to hold above the $60 support zone; moving-average resistance near 65.
calls.reason: Silver faces the same yield pressure plus heavy industrial-demand risk, so it has more hurdles than gold; long-term thesis intact.
calls.quote: gold right now has fewer hurdles to climb than silver does

notes: Date: no weekday or date spoken, but he reacts to the same-day PCE/inflation release and ADP +90K, which Ricky Gutierrez's Wed 2026-09-30 video also reports, so 2026-09-30 (listing approx 10-01); date_source marked 'transcript' on that inference. Prices quoted live while recording (gold ~4,154 -0.63%, silver just over $60, -2%). Short-term bias recorded as neutral/cautious: he does not forecast a crash despite the title. Silver action 'hold' reflects 'long-term stacker, stay where you are' plus his preference for gold over silver. Timestamps are the transcript's minute markers (m:00), so accurate to the minute only.
